title: What Gears of War's E-Day took from Dom Santiago
subject: dom
description:
Would Dom have kept fighting if his kids had lived? 👇

Before Gears of War: E-Day arrives on October 6, here is everything Dom Santiago lost the day the Locust emerged. Spoilers for the Gears of War series lore.

scenes.text: Dom Santiago was still a teenager when he became a father.
Maria was the girl next door. Dom grew up with her, his brother Carlos, and his best friend Marcus Fenix.
They married and had a son, Benedicto. Then the Pendulum Wars took Carlos at Aspho Fields.
That year his daughter Sylvia Carla was born, named for the brother he lost.
But peace never came. On Emergence Day, the Locust burst from underground.
